name: Bastiodon the Defender & Rampardos the Attacker Constructed Half Decks

releases.name: Bastiodon the Defender & Rampardos the Attacker Constructed Half Decks

description.text: Two Japanese half decks released on 2 March 2007, the same day as the Secret of the Lakes expansion: Rampardos the Attacker and Bastiodon the Defender. Their theme is the Underground that runs beneath the Sinnoh region in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl, where fossils are dug up and restored, and each is led by one of the two fossil Pokémon: an offensive deck and a defensive one. Each 30-card deck came with damage counters and markers, a coin and a how-to-play book, so two friends could each bring one and play.
